description.value: The Thornhill Pub is a log cabin-style neighbourhood pub in Terrace, BC, situated near the local golf course and serving hearty comfort food including fresh-made burgers, all-day breakfast, and an extensive appetizer menu. It bills itself as the best pub in Terrace and caters to both locals and travellers passing through the North Coast corridor. Touring cyclists will find a substantial menu with dine-in and takeout options to refuel after a long day on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thornhillpubterrace.ca is live and presents a full menu confirming the business is active as a dine-in/takeout pub in Terrace, BC; no closure indicators are present. The phone number 250-638-8404 appears prominently on the website, while OSM carries no phone number. Takeout is explicitly advertised ('DINE IN • TAKE OUT') and a Veggie Burger is listed as a vegetarian menu option; no cyclist-specific amenities such as bike parking, Wi-Fi, or water refill are mentioned anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; 250-638-8404 is sourced from the website only and cannot be cross-checked against OSM.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, active pub in Terrace, BC with a live website, full menu, and clear signs of ongoing operation — a useful food and drink stop for touring cyclists on the North Coast route.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Veggie Burger listed on menu with description 'Tastes so good you'll want it every day'
